proof_body:
by
  intro K L _ _ _ _ I x y hI hx
  have h := LieIdeal.le_killingCompl_top_of_isLieAbelian K L I hx
  rw [LieIdeal.mem_killingCompl] at h
  rw [LieModule.traceForm_comm]
  exact h y (LieSubmodule.mem_top y)
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) (L : Type*) [Field K] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra K L] [FiniteDimensional K L] (I : LieIdeal K L) (x y : L), IsLieAbelian I → x ∈ I → killingForm K L x y = 0
